# FIP-011 Pagination and Scroll

Use the lifecycle in `.github/prompts/phase1-frontend-implementation.prompt.md`.

## Authorization

Invocation of this prompt authorizes **FIP-011 only**. Do not implement any later FIP. Do not commit or push.

## Primary Source

`docs/fip-011-pagination-and-scroll-plan.md`

Read this Primary Source before editing. It is the implementation authority for this FIP.

## Context Rule

Do **not** preload requirements, MVP, architecture, API, security, UI, test, decisions, Phase 0 review, Cross-Phase review, or other FIP documents. If the Primary Source leaves one concrete implementation question unresolved, read only the exact supporting document/section that the Primary Source cites for that question. Stop if the conflict or ambiguity still affects implementation.

## Scope and Files

Derive scope, expected/allowed files, prohibited files/work, dependencies, and Acceptance Criteria directly from the Primary Source. Do not duplicate or reinterpret them in this prompt.

For visual behavior, also read `docs/alice-experience-visual-baseline.md` because UI-BL-001 is the frozen visual baseline. Do not preload other visual documents; open a specifically referenced section only if the Primary Source requires it.

## Validation and Gate

- If the Primary Source defines exact commands, run them exactly.
- Otherwise apply the Deterministic Test Policy in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Ordinary code/test defects may be fixed autonomously with focused test reruns.
- Final gate requires the full required regression check and Acceptance Criteria self-review.
- Report `PASS` or `BLOCKED`, then stop. Do not start the next FIP.
